import requests, sys, time, uuid

BASE = '{{TESTVDB_DB_URL}}'

# Test: state_residual on /v1/schema/{className} - delete class and verify it's gone
c = f'TestStateResidual_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}'
print(f"Testing state_residual on class {c}")

# Create the class
r = requests.post(f'{BASE}/v1/schema', json={
    'class': c,
    'vectorizer': 'none',
    'vectorIndexConfig': {
        'distance': 'cosine',
        'efConstruction': 128,
        'maxConnections': 32,
        'dynamicEfMin': 100,
        'dynamicEfMax': 500,
        'dynamicEfFactor': 8,
        'flatSearchCutoff': 40000
    },
    'replicationConfig': {'factor': 1},
    'multiTenancyConfig': {'enabled': False},
    'properties': [{'name': 'text', 'dataType': ['text']}]
})
assert r.status_code == 200, f'create failed: {r.text}'
time.sleep(0.5)

# Insert some objects
ids = [str(uuid.uuid4()) for _ in range(3)]
for i, oid in enumerate(ids):
    r = requests.post(f'{BASE}/v1/objects', json={
        'class': c,
        'id': oid,
        'vector': [0.1*(i+1), 0.2*(i+1), 0.3*(i+1), 0.4*(i+1)],
        'properties': {'text': f'item{i}'}
    })
    assert r.status_code == 200, f'insert failed: {r.text}'
time.sleep(1)

# Verify class exists
r = requests.get(f'{BASE}/v1/schema/{c}')
assert r.status_code == 200, f'class should exist: {r.text}'
print(f"  Class exists before delete: OK")

# Delete the class
r = requests.delete(f'{BASE}/v1/schema/{c}')
print(f"  Delete status: {r.status_code}")
time.sleep(0.5)

# Verify class is gone - should get 404
r = requests.get(f'{BASE}/v1/schema/{c}')
if r.status_code == 200:
    print(f'[DEFECT: STATE_VIOLATION] Class still exists after delete!')
    sys.exit(1)
elif r.status_code == 404:
    print(f'  Class properly deleted: status={r.status_code}')
    sys.exit(0)
else:
    print(f'  Unexpected status after delete: {r.status_code}')
    sys.exit(0)
